steps.title: Meet Mother Quince
steps.goal: Talk to Mother Quince in the middle of Quince Grove.

steps.title: Seedling Row
steps.goal: Wake Seedling Row and find the Sprout Charm.

steps.title: Honey Hollow
steps.goal: Wake Honey Hollow with your Sprout Charm and find the Honey Charm.

steps.title: Quince Maze
steps.goal: Wake Quince Maze with your Honey Charm and find the Quince Charm.

steps.title: Greenhouse Glass
steps.goal: Wake Greenhouse Glass with your Quince Charm and find the Glass Charm.

steps.title: Vine Cellar
steps.goal: Wake Vine Cellar with your Glass Charm and find the Gourd Charm.

steps.title: The Overgrown Greenhouse
steps.goal: Wake The Overgrown Greenhouse with your Gourd Charm and find the Heart Charm.

steps.title: Back to the Grove
steps.goal: Tell Mother Quince that the orchard blooms in order again.
